name: Saturn's Subtitle Tweaks
description: Saturn's Subtitle Tweaks (SST) enhances Jellyfin playback with in-player subtitle search. Version 1.1.1.0 is a crash-fix release: the plugin must not take down the Jellyfin server. Requires a configured subtitle provider (e.g., Open Subtitles).
overview: In-player subtitle search for Jellyfin Web. v1.1.1.0 does not crash the server on load.

versions.changelog: Fix: Jellyfin no longer crashes on plugin load. Delayed File Transformation registration, no webpack-bundle rewriting, pinned Jellyfin.Controller 10.11.0.
